# Result: Cannot compute

The embedded emissions for this shipment cannot be determined under the supplied ruleset. I have not estimated a figure.

## Input check

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) Good CN code in the table | 7214 20 00 (rebar) | ✅ Present in table |
| (b) Country of production listed for that good | United States | ❌ **Not listed** |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 1,200 t | ✅ Provided |

## Missing input

- **A default SEE for CN 7214 20 00 with country of production = United States.** The table lists this CN code only for Türkiye (2.31), China (3.169) and India (4.27). The ruleset selects the SEE jointly by CN code and country, and says not to estimate if the country is not in the table.

## What I did not do

I did not use any of the listed countries' values as a stand-in, nor an average or maximum of them. Any of these would be an estimate, which the ruleset prohibits.

## To complete the calculation

Supply a factor table entry for **7214 20 00 | United States** with its default SEE. The result would then be:

> Embedded emissions = SEE(7214 20 00, United States) × 1,200 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
